projects.water: Lawson Pond, Rabbit Chase Creek, Wetlands A and C

position.text: Position: address match for 1165 West Valley Road (US Census geocoder), inside Section 12, T35N R4W as the order states. The pond itself is not a named feature.

summary.text: Remove a 1940s earthen dam and 18-inch culvert spillway that no longer meets dam safety standards and rebuild in the same footprint with two 24-inch culverts and an emergency spillway. The pond is dewatered during work, which also removes its largemouth bass, the only fish found in a 2024 survey.
